versions.changelog:
- Updated skill description to clarify sanctions and compliance features for agents.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality or endpoints; documentation improved for clarity.

- Initial release of GoCreative Compliance skill.
- Enables compliance and risk screening for AI agents, including KYB, sanctions (OFAC/EU/UK/UN), PEP, and watchlist checks.
- Offers a one-shot PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict and 0-100 risk scores for entities.
- All endpoints are pay-per-call in USDC via x402—no API key or signup required.
- Integrates real regulatory data sources: OFAC SDN, GLEIF, and CFPB.
- Useful for onboarding, vendor payment, counterparty checks, and ongoing monitoring.
